goal: Validate java-code-review for large-project Java backend reviews without letting parser or golden wording redefine the runtime skill.

signals.quality: Find the intended high-risk issue with concrete evidence and without must-not findings.
signals.scope: Stay within the intended review scope and disclose any pending or excluded scope honestly.
signals.workflow: Produce the workflow signals needed for the benchmark layer, including Chinese table findings where applicable.

layers.description: Rule-hit benchmark for compact review mode.

cases.scenario: Return and log full sensitive user fields.

expected_findings.expected_issue: 直接回傳完整敏感資料，沒有做最小化與脫敏。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 不要直接回傳完整敏感欄位，改為最小化欄位與遮罩後 DTO。

expected_findings.expected_issue: 直接把完整 user 物件寫入日誌，沒有做脫敏。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 避免記錄完整 user object，改記 userId 或脫敏後欄位。

cases.scenario: Call equals on a nullable status field.

expected_findings.expected_issue: 可能為 null 的值主動呼叫 equals，存在 NullPointerException 風險。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 改用常量發起 equals，例如 "PAID".equals(order.getStatus())，必要時補 null guard。

expected_findings.expected_issue: 可能為 null 的值主動呼叫 equals，存在 NullPointerException 風險。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 改用常量發起 equals，例如 "VIP".equals(member.getLevel())，必要時補 null guard。

cases.scenario: Call external payment inside a local transaction.

expected_findings.expected_issue: 在 @Transactional 交易內直接呼叫外部支付系統，可能破壞交易一致性。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 把外部呼叫移出本地交易邊界，或改用可補償的非同步 / outbox 設計。

cases.scenario: Non-repeatable payment or coupon flow without idempotency.

expected_findings.expected_issue: 不可重複執行的發券流程看不到冪等設計，重試時可能重複發券。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 在發券邊界使用 requestId 或其他 idempotency key，搭配唯一約束、狀態檢查或 duplicate handling，避免重複發券。

cases.scenario: Request status directly overwrites persisted status.

expected_findings.expected_issue: 業務狀態直接使用 request 傳入值覆蓋，缺少目前狀態是否合法轉移的顯式校驗。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 先檢查目前狀態是否允許轉移到目標狀態，再由集中式狀態流轉邏輯更新狀態。

cases.scenario: Controller uses Entity for request and response.

expected_findings.expected_issue: Request DTO、Response DTO 與 Entity 直接混用，會讓 API 邊界與資料模型耦合。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 改用明確的 CreateUserRequest 與 UserResponse，避免直接接收或回傳 Entity。

cases.scenario: Business time logic uses local now without timezone or boundary clarity.

expected_findings.expected_issue: 時間判斷直接依賴不明確的本機 now，且結束邊界是否包含終點不清楚。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 改用明確業務時區與 Clock，並定義可驗證的起訖邊界，例如左閉右開 [start, end)。

cases.scenario: Cache stores full token or other sensitive value.

expected_findings.expected_issue: Cache 中直接存放完整敏感資料與 access token，缺少最小化與保護。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 不要把完整敏感資料與 token 直接放進 cache，只保留必要欄位，必要時改存脫敏值或短期識別資訊。

cases.scenario: Logging path performs unconditional expensive string assembly or serialization.

expected_findings.expected_issue: 高頻路徑使用無條件字串拼接與序列化日誌，會造成不必要的效能成本。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 改用參數化日誌，若需要昂貴序列化則先用 log level guard。

expected_findings.expected_issue: 迴圈中的無條件字串拼接與序列化日誌會造成不必要的效能成本。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 改用參數化日誌，若序列化成本高則加 log level guard，避免在迴圈中每次都做昂貴字串組裝。

cases.scenario: A single application method mixes validation, persistence, side effects, and notifications.

expected_findings.expected_issue: 單一方法同時處理驗證、查詢、組裝、持久化、通知與稽核，違反單一職責。
expected_findings.expected_evidence: submitOrder validation findById save reserve consume sendCreatedEmail record
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 拆分成 validation、載入使用者、建立訂單、持久化、通知與稽核等明確方法。

layers.description: Diff and pull-request review scope benchmark.

cases.scenario: Changed file exposes sensitive data while unchanged distractor file has a separate severe issue.

expected_findings.expected_issue: Diff 直接回傳完整敏感資料，沒有做最小化與脫敏。
expected_findings.expected_evidence: 完整手機 Email 卡號 移除脫敏
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 不要在 response 直接回傳完整敏感欄位，改為最小化欄位與脫敏後值。

cases.scenario: A small diff introduces nullable equals risk.

expected_findings.expected_issue: Diff 對可能為 null 的值主動呼叫 equals，存在 NullPointerException 風險。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 改用常量發起 equals，例如 "PAID".equals(order.getStatus())，必要時補 null guard。

cases.scenario: A narrow service diff moves an external call inside a transaction.

expected_findings.expected_issue: Diff 在 @Transactional 交易內直接呼叫外部支付系統，可能破壞交易一致性。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 把外部呼叫移出本地交易邊界，或改用可補償的非同步 / outbox 設計。

cases.scenario: A controller diff starts accepting or returning Entity directly.

expected_findings.expected_issue: Diff 直接使用 Entity 作為 request 與 response，會讓 API 邊界與資料模型耦合。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 改用明確的 CreateUserRequest 與 UserResponse，避免直接接收或回傳 Entity。

cases.scenario: A small diff turns lightweight logging into unconditional expensive serialization inside a loop.

expected_findings.expected_issue: Diff 在迴圈中使用無條件字串拼接與序列化日誌，會造成不必要的效能成本。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 改用參數化日誌，若序列化成本高則加 log level guard，避免在迴圈中每次都做昂貴字串組裝。

cases.scenario: Diff changes cache key/value logic only in one method.
expected_findings: cache key or sensitive cache payload issue when visible
scope_guards: must stay near changed cache code

expected_findings.expected_issue: Diff 在 cache value 中直接放入完整 email 與 access token，缺少敏感資料最小化與保護。
expected_findings.expected_recommendation: 不要把完整敏感欄位與 token 直接放進 cache，改存必要且脫敏後的資料，並保留明確 TTL/清除策略。

cases.scenario: PR changes only tests or review docs.
Two changed files together break multi-table consistency.
An unchanged file contains a much worse issue than the changed file.
expected_findings: only changed-file issue or no finding if diff is safe
scope_guards: do not chase unrelated severe distractor

layers.description: Project-scale workflow benchmark for large codebase review mode.

cases.scenario: More than ten Java files require a real inventory.
A workspace large enough to force batch planning.
Mixed reviewed and pending modules should be tracked with a ledger.
Security, transaction, and naming issues coexist; high-risk findings must come first.
expected_findings: security or transaction issue prioritized before style

cases.scenario: Controller, service, cache, and async files together reveal one business risk.
The benchmark intentionally contains more files than one pass should review fully.
The first pass should end with a continuation prompt for the next batch.
Workspace includes generated, non-Java, or excluded files.
